rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent dominant mass in all four views, with a clear primary block and a small subtractive notch, so it avoids fragmentation. It is also well-contained within the parcel in the visible views and does not show obvious cross-view collisions. The main weakness is programmatic: for neighborhood living / mixed-use, the mass is too sealed and too box-like at the street edge. The verified access edge is acknowledged only weakly; the notch does not yet produce a convincingly public ground threshold or terrace. The silhouette has some stepped/relieved character, but it is not yet a strong capacity-bearing section, more a simple clipped volume than a legible inhabited section. Overall it is plausible as an early mass, but it needs a clearer carved public void and a stronger ground response to the access frontage.
